Resolves #21431

🌿 *A modal dialog can no longer leave its mask over the page by being destroyed instead of closed.*

`dialog.Base` gets a `destroy()` override: a modal dialog on the page releases its mask before it leaves, whether it closes or its owner destroys it. `close()` drops its own `syncModalMask(me.id, false)`, which `destroy(true)` now runs; the animated close reaches the same path through `closeOrHide(false)`. In `examples/dialog` with Modal checked, `destroyNeoInstance` on the open dialog used to leave `.neo-dialog-modal-mask` as the element at the page centre; at the head the mask is gone and the centre is the viewport.

Evidence: L3 (unit spec of the main-thread calls in CI; e2e `examples/dialog` in CI; a browser check of the direct destroy) → L3 required (AC-1, AC-2). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/dialog/Close.spec.mjs`, "a modal dialog its owner destroys without close() takes its mask along; one never shown leaves it alone". The mask then moves under the topmost remaining modal, which `test/playwright/unit/main/DomAccessModalMask.spec.mjs` pins. |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: the same spec, "a close syncs the mask away before destroy() removes the dialog, with no timer left behind"; `test/playwright/e2e/dialog/CloseFocus.spec.mjs` |

## Deltas from ticket

- **The close case of `Close.spec.mjs` now closes a dialog on the page.** It closed a dialog that never mounted, and only a dialog on the page holds the mask: `destroy()` leaves the mask alone for one that never showed, so a teardown never calls into a window for nothing.

## Test Evidence

Red proof: against `dev`'s `dialog/Base.mjs`, the new arm fails and the other five pass. At 25c25f2635: `e2e/dialog`, 10 passed; the unit specs that import the dialog (`dialog/`, `desktop/`, `board/CardEditor`, `scheduler/Container`, `main/DomAccessModalMask`), 128 passed. In `examples/dialog`, an open modal dialog destroyed through `Neo.worker.App.destroyNeoInstance`:

| | the dialog | `.neo-dialog-modal-mask` | element at the page centre |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dev` | gone | `display: block` | the mask |
| head | gone | removed | `neo-viewport-1` |

### 🔬 Depth Floor

**Challenge OR documented search (per guide §7.1):**

- **Challenge**: Calling bare `dialog.destroy()` without `updateParentVdom = true` on a standalone floating dialog (`parentId: 'document.body'`) now releases `.neo-dialog-modal-mask` via `syncModalMask(me.id, false)`, whereas `component.Abstract#destroy(false)` only emits the `removeNode` delta when `updateParentVdom` is `true` (`close()` passes `me.destroy(true)` and `App#destroyNeoInstance` also passes `true`). An owner holding a floating `Dialog` reference and calling `this.dialog.destroy()` with no arguments no longer traps the page behind an orphaned mask, though its detached `#neo-dialog-N` DOM shell remains until `destroy(true)` is used — inherited from `component.Abstract#destroy`'s opt-in `updateParentVdom` contract and non-blocking here.
